title: Conflict-free, double-buffered GEMM tile (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C compiled by arena.cuda_c.CudaProgram, executed on arena.cuda_sim.GPU.
32x32 x 32x32 GEMM (K=64, two 32-wide K-tiles), single block of 1024 threads, col = threadIdx.x/32, row = threadIdx.x%32 so a whole warp shares one col and varies row.
smem_wave_ratio is measured shared-memory waves divided by the conflict-free, double-buffered lower bound the grader computes itself.

This simulator's cost model is a simple additive sum (no pipeline overlap), so it cannot measure the LATENCY-HIDING benefit of double buffering -- only whether the buffer-swap indexing is correct (max_abs_err) and whether the tile layout is bank-conflict-free (smem_wave_ratio).
